- Initial public release.
- Provides access to Artsonia student-art portfolios, comments, and fan management via MCP.
- Includes core tools for listing students, fetching portfolios and artwork details, downloading artwork, managing comments and fans, and setting notifications.
- Offers setup instructions for both npx and source installation.
- Documentation covers authentication and all supported environment variables.
